40002876.author: पदार्थः
40002876.content: वेदपारगा: wellversed in the Vedas, ते those, ब्राम्हणा: brahmins, तां रजनीम् that night, उष्य after staying, सहराजपुरोहिता: along with royal priests, उपस्थानम् to the pavilion (for consecration ceremony), उपतस्थु: assembled.

40002876.author: Translation
40002876.content: The brahmins wellversed in the Vedas stayed waiting all night and assembled at the pavilion (for the consecration ceremony) along with royal priests.

40002877.author: पदार्थः
40002877.content: अमात्या: ministers, बलमुख्याश्च army chiefs, ये निगमस्य मुख्याः chiefs of the merchants' associations, राघवस्य of Rama, अभिषेकार्थे for the consecration, प्रियमाणा: brimming with joy, संगता: assembled.

40002877.author: Translation
40002877.content: For the consecration of the scion of the Raghu race (Rama), ministers, army chiefs and chiefs of merchants' associations assembled, brimming with joy.

40002878.author: पदार्थः
40002878.content: विमले bright, सूर्ये Sun, उदिते having arisen, अहनि during day , पुष्ये च when Pushya star, अभ्यागते was ascendent, रामस्य Rama's, जन्म स्थिते constellation at the time of birth, कर्कटकलग्ने ascension of karkataka lagna, प्राप्ते had come, रामस्य Rama's, अभिषेकाय for the consecration, द्विजेन्द्रै: by the best of brahmins, उपकल्पितम् was decided.

40002878.author: Translation
40002878.content: The best of brahmins had decided to perform the consecration ceremony after the  bright Sun appeared in the sky when the Pushya star approached the karkataka lagna, which was the constellation at the time of Rama's birth.

40002879.author: पदार्थः
40002879.content: काञ्चना: golden, जलकुम्भाश्च jars filled with water, स्वलंकृतम् welldecorated, भद्रपीठम् throne, भास्वता by a bright, व्याघ्रचर्मणा by the tiger skin, सम्यक् properly, आस्तीर्ण:  spread, रथः च chariot also, (भान्ति are shining.)

40002879.author: Translation
40002879.content: Golden jars filled with water, the welldecorated throne and a chariot  spread well with  bright tigerskin (were kept ready).

40002880.author: पदार्थः
40002880.content: पुण्यात् from sacred, गङ्गायमुनयो: सङ्गमात् from the confluence of Ganga and Yamuna, पुण्या: holy, अन्या: other, या:सरित: streams, ह्रदा: ponds, कूपा: wells, सरांसि च lakes as well, आहृतम्  brought, जलम् water, प्राग्वाहा: flowing eastwards, ऊर्ध्ववाहा: flowing upwards, तिर्यग्वाहा: flowing zigzag, समाहिता: joined together, ताभ्य: च from them also, सर्वश: from all directions, समुद्रेभ्य: from all seas, आहृतम् has been collected, तोयम् water.

40002880.author: Translation
40002880.content: Water had been fetched from the sacred confluence of Ganga and Yamuna, from other  holy streams, wells, ponds and lakes, from rivers flowing eastward, westward, and  zigzag, from rivers from all directions joined together. And from all the seas.

40002881.author: पदार्थः
40002881.content: पुण्यात् from sacred, गङ्गायमुनयो: सङ्गमात् from the confluence of Ganga and Yamuna, पुण्या: holy, अन्या: other, या:सरित: streams, ह्रदा: ponds, कूपा: wells, सरांसि च lakes as well, आहृतम्  brought, जलम् water, प्राग्वाहा: flowing eastwards, ऊर्ध्ववाहा: flowing upwards, तिर्यग्वाहा: flowing zigzag, समाहिता: joined together, ताभ्य: च from them also, सर्वश: from all directions, समुद्रेभ्य: from all seas, आहृतम् has been collected, तोयम् water.

40002881.author: Translation
40002881.content: Water had been fetched from the sacred confluence of Ganga and Yamuna, from other  holy streams, wells, ponds and lakes, from rivers flowing eastward, westward, and  zigzag, from rivers from all directions joined together. And from all the seas.

40002882.author: पदार्थः
40002882.content: सलाजा: with puffed corn, क्षीरिभि: leaves from trees rich in sap, छन्ना: covered, पद्मोत्पलयुता:  with lotuses and waterlilies, परमवारिणा holy water, पूर्णा: filled with, काञ्चनराजता: made of gold and silver, घटा: vessels, भान्ति are shining.

40002882.author: Translation
40002882.content: Gold and silver vessels filled with holy water and puffed corn, adorned with lotuses, water lilies and leaves from trees rich in sap shone.

40002883.author: पदार्थः
40002883.content: क्षौद्रम् honey, दधि curds, घृतम् ghee, लाजा: puffed grain, दर्भा: darbha grass, सुमनस: flowers, पय: milk, शुभाचारा: wellmannered, सर्वाभरणभूषिता: adorned with all types of ornaments, वेश्या: च एव courtesans as well.

40002883.author: Translation
40002883.content: Honey, curd, ghee, puffed grain, darbha grass, flowers and milk were arranged. Wellmannered courtesans adorned with all kinds of ornaments (stood in position).

40002884.author: पदार्थः
40002884.content: चन्द्रांशुविकचप्रख्यम् resembling diffused rays of the moon, काञ्चनम् made of gold, रत्नभूषितम् adorned with gems, रामस्य for Rama, उत्तमम् excellent, वालव्यजनम् a fan made of yak's tail, सज्जं तिष्ठति is held in readiness.

40002884.author: Translation
40002884.content: An excellent fan of yak's tail with a staff of gold  studded with gems looking like diffused moonbeams was kept ready.

40002885.author: पदार्थः
40002885.content: चन्द्रमण्डलसंकाशम् resembling the Moon's orb, पाण्डुरम् pale white, द्युतिकरम् lustrous like the pole star अभिषेकपुरस्कृतम् to be placed in front of the coronation pavilion, श्रीमत् majestic, आतपत्रं umbrella, सज्जम् is arranged.

40002885.author: Translation
40002885.content: A lustrous pale white umbrella resembling the Moon's orb or the pole star was kept in front of the coronation pavilion.

40002886.author: पदार्थः
40002886.content: पाण्डुर: pale white, वृष: bull, सज्ज: is kept ready, अश्व:च horse also, सुस्थित: in state, प्रसृत: flowing ichor (from its temples), श्रीमान् majestic, औपवाह्य: worthy of ride by a king, गज: च elephant also, प्रतीक्षते is awaiting.

40002886.author: Translation
40002886.content: A bull and a horse both pale white and a majestic elephant in rut worthy of royal ride stood waiting.

40002887.author: पदार्थः
40002887.content: सर्वाभरणभूषिता: adorned with all kinds of ornament, माङ्गल्या: auspicious, अष्टौ eight, कन्या:unmarried girls, सर्वाणि all sorts of, वादित्राणि musical instruments, वन्दिन: च also panegyrists, तथा and, परे others (stood waiting).

40002887.author: Translation
40002887.content: Eight auspicious maidens adorned with all types of ornaments, all sorts of musical instruments, panegyrists and others (were in waiting).

40002888.author: पदार्थः
40002888.content: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् of the descendants of the Ikshvakus, राज्ये in the kingdom, अभिषेचनम् consecration, यथा as, संभ्रियेत् might have been arranged, तथा जातीयम् pertaining to that race, राजपुत्राभिषेचनम् for the consecration of the prince, आदाय having brought, राजवचनात् in accordance with the order of the king, तत्र there, समवेता: having assembled, ते they, महीपतिम् to the king, अपश्यन्त: not beholding, न: about us, क: नु who indeed, राज्ञ: to the king, प्रतिवेदयेत् inform, अब्रुवन् said, राजानम् to the king, न च पश्याम: (we) do not see, दिवाकर: च sun also, उदित: has risen, धीमत: sagacious, रामस्य Rama's, यौवराज्याभिषेक: च consecration as prince regent, सज्ज: is ready.

40002888.author: Translation
40002888.content: Just as articles necessary for the consecration of the descendants of the Ikshvakus, are customarily arranged in the kingdom, in the same way things were arranged for the coronation of the prince belonging to that race. All those who had assembled there in response to the order of the king could not see him and so they said to themselves 'Who will inform the king of our arrival. Everything is kept ready for consecration of the sagacious Rama as prince regent. The Sun has risen. But we do not find the king'.

40002889.author: पदार्थः
40002889.content: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् of the descendants of the Ikshvakus, राज्ये in the kingdom, अभिषेचनम् consecration, यथा as, संभ्रियेत् might have been arranged, तथा जातीयम् pertaining to that race, राजपुत्राभिषेचनम् for the consecration of the prince, आदाय having brought, राजवचनात् in accordance with the order of the king, तत्र there, समवेता: having assembled, ते they, महीपतिम् to the king, अपश्यन्त: not beholding, न: about us, क: नु who indeed, राज्ञ: to the king, प्रतिवेदयेत् inform, अब्रुवन् said, राजानम् to the king, न च पश्याम: (we) do not see, दिवाकर: च sun also, उदित: has risen, धीमत: sagacious, रामस्य Rama's, यौवराज्याभिषेक: च consecration as prince regent, सज्ज: is ready.

40002889.author: Translation
40002889.content: Just as articles necessary for the consecration of the descendants of the Ikshvakus, are customarily arranged in the kingdom, in the same way things were arranged for the coronation of the prince belonging to that race. All those who had assembled there in response to the order of the king could not see him and so they said to themselves 'Who will inform the king of our arrival. Everything is kept ready for consecration of the sagacious Rama as prince regent. The Sun has risen. But we do not find the king'.

40002890.author: पदार्थः
40002890.content: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् of the descendants of the Ikshvakus, राज्ये in the kingdom, अभिषेचनम् consecration, यथा as, संभ्रियेत् might have been arranged, तथा जातीयम् pertaining to that race, राजपुत्राभिषेचनम् for the consecration of the prince, आदाय having brought, राजवचनात् in accordance with the order of the king, तत्र there, समवेता: having assembled, ते they, महीपतिम् to the king, अपश्यन्त: not beholding, न: about us, क: नु who indeed, राज्ञ: to the king, प्रतिवेदयेत् inform, अब्रुवन् said, राजानम् to the king, न च पश्याम: (we) do not see, दिवाकर: च sun also, उदित: has risen, धीमत: sagacious, रामस्य Rama's, यौवराज्याभिषेक: च consecration as prince regent, सज्ज: is ready.

40002890.author: Translation
40002890.content: Just as articles necessary for the consecration of the descendants of the Ikshvakus, are customarily arranged in the kingdom, in the same way things were arranged for the coronation of the prince belonging to that race. All those who had assembled there in response to the order of the king could not see him and so they said to themselves 'Who will inform the king of our arrival. Everything is kept ready for consecration of the sagacious Rama as prince regent. The Sun has risen. But we do not find the king'.

40002891.author: पदार्थः
40002891.content: तेषु while they, इति thus, ब्रुवाणेषु were speaking, राजसत्कृत: the king's confidant, सुमन्त्र: Sumantra, तान् them, सर्वान् all, सार्वभौमान् sovereigns, महीपतीन् kings, इदम् this word, अब्रवीत् said.

40002891.author: Translation
40002891.content: While the sovereign monarchs who hailed from different parts of the earth were thus talking Sumantra the king's confidant said:

40002892.author: पदार्थः
40002892.content: अहम् I, राज्ञ: king's, नियोगेन by command, रामम् Rama, त्वरया quickly, प्रस्थित: अस्मि I am departing, भवन्त: तु as for all of you, राज्ञ: to the king, पूज्या: venerable, विशेषत: especially, रामस्य च for Rama also.

40002892.author: Translation
40002892.content: In obedience to the king's command I am hurrying for Rama. All of you are honourable to king Dasaratha, especially to Rama.

40002893.author: पदार्थः
40002893.content: अयम् अहम् such I am, आयुष्मताम् longlived, वचनात् by your words, संप्रति बुद्धस्य to him now awake, राज्ञ: king's, सुखम् welfare, आगमनकारणं the reason for his coming, पृच्छामि I shall ask.

40002893.author: Translation
40002893.content: On your behalf I shall enquire from the king who is awake now about his welfare and the reason for calling me here.

40002894.author: पदार्थः
40002894.content: पुराणवित् one who is wellversed in history and tradition, सुमन्त्र: Sumantra, इति thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, अन्त:पुरद्वारम् entrance to the inner apartment, आजगाम approached, सदा always, सक्तम् remains closed, तत् that, वेश्म palace, प्रविवेश ह entered.

40002894.author: Translation
40002894.content: Having said so, Sumantra who was versed in history and tradition  approached the inner apartment which always remains closed.

40002895.author: पदार्थः
40002895.content: तदा then, स: he, प्रविश्य having entered, अस्य this, विशांपते: king's, वंशम् royal dynasty, तुष्टाव extoled, नरेन्द्रस्य king's, तत् शयनीयम् sleeping apartment, आसाद्य having approached, व्यतिष्ठत stood there.

40002895.author: Translation
40002895.content: Entering the king's inner apartment, he began extoling the virtues of the royal dynasty, and stood there as he approached the king's bedchamber.

40002896.author: पदार्थः
40002896.content: स: he, तत् वेश्म that bedchamber, तिरस्करिणम् अन्तरा behind the screen, आसाद्य having approached, गुणयुक्ताभि: with virtues, अशीर्भि: with blessings, राघवम् son of Raghus dynasty (Dasaratha), अभितुष्टाव praised.

40002896.author: Translation
40002896.content: Having approached the king's bedchamber Sumatra stood behind the screen, singing his glory and seeking the blessings (of God) on this son of Raghus dynasty.

40002897.author: पदार्थः
40002897.content: काकुत्स्थ O scion of the Kakutsthas (Dasaratha), सोमसूर्यौ Moon and Sun, शिववैश्रवणौ अपि Siva and Kubera also, वरुण: Varuna, अग्नि: Agni, इन्द्र: Indra, ते to you, विजयम् victory, प्रदिशन्तु let them grant.

40002897.author: Translation
40002897.content: O scion of the kakutsthas (Dasaratha), may Moon and Sun, Siva and Kubera, Varuna, Agni and Indra grant you victory

40002898.author: पदार्थः
40002898.content: भगवती holy, रात्रि: night, गता has passed, शिवम् auspicious, अह: day, उपस्थितम् has arrived, नृपशार्दुल O tiger among kings, बुद्ध्यस्व may wake up, अनन्तरम् later, कार्यम् acts, कुरु perform.

40002898.author: Translation
40002898.content: The holy night has passed and the auspicious day has arrived. O tiger among kings,  awaken and attend to your duties.

40002899.author: पदार्थः
40002899.content: राघव born in the family of Raghu, नृप O king, ब्राह्मणा: brahmins, बलमुख्या: च army commanders, नैगमा: च merchants also, आगता: have arrived, दर्शनम् your audience, (अभि)  कांक्षन्ते request, प्रतिबुध्यस्व may awaken.

40002899.author: Translation
40002899.content: O scion of the Raghu dynasty brahmins, army commanders and merchants have arrived and they beseech your audience. Please awake.

40002900.author: पदार्थः
40002900.content: तत: thereafter, राजा king, प्रतिबुध्य being awake, तदा then, स्तुवन्तम् extoling, तम् मन्त्रकोविदम्  expert counseller, सूतम् charioteer, सुमंत्रम् to Sumantra, इदं वचनम् this word, अब्रवीत् said.

40002900.author: Translation
40002900.content: Dasaratha waking up saw the charioteer and expert counsellor Sumantra extoling him, and said:

40002901.author: पदार्थः
40002901.content: सूत O charioteer, रामम् Rama, आनय bring, इति thus, अनया by her, यत् अभिहित: असि you have been told, येन why, मम my, आज्ञा command, प्रतिहन्यते has been disregarded, इदं कारणं किम् what is the reason?

40002901.author: Translation
40002901.content: You had been asked by her (Kaikeyi) to bring Rama here. What is the reason the command is disregarded?

40002902.author: पदार्थः
40002902.content: अहम् I, न च एव संप्रसुप्त: I have not slept, आशु instantly, राघवम् to son of the Raghus (Rama), इह here, आनय bring, इति thus, राजा दशरथ: king Dasaratha, तत्र there, सूतम् to the charioteer, पुन: again, अन्वशात् ordered.

40002902.author: Translation
40002902.content: I did not sleep (last night). Bring Rama here at once, said king Dasaratha to the charioteer again.

40002903.author: पदार्थः
40002903.content: स: he, राजवचनम् words of the king, श्रुत्वा having heard, तम् him, शिरसा bowing with his head down, प्रतिपूज्य offering salutations, महत् great, प्रियम् happy, मन्यमान: while reflecting, नृपावासात् from the kings's palace, निर्जगाम went out.

40002903.author: Translation
40002903.content: At these words of the king, he offered his salutations by bowing his head and left the king's apartment, reflecting on the great happy event.

40002904.author: पदार्थः
40002904.content: सूत: charioteer, प्रसन्न: cheerful, पताकाध्वजशोभितम् bedecked with pennants and banners, राजमार्गं च highway also, विलोकयन् seeing, हृष्ट: rejoiced, प्रमुदित: delighted, जगाम went.

40002904.author: Translation
40002904.content: The charioteer left cheerfully, happily looking at the highway bedecked with pennants and banners.

40002905.author: पदार्थः
40002905.content: स: सूत: that charioteer, तत्र there, हृष्टवत् happy, सर्वलोकस्य of all the citizens, अभिषेचनसंयुक्ता: relating to installation, रामाधिकरणा: in connection with Rama, कथा: conversation, श्रुश्राव heard.

40002905.author: Translation
40002905.content: The charioteer heard the conversation relating to Rama and his consecration among the happy citizens.

40002906.author: पदार्थः
40002906.content: तत: thereafter, सुमन्त्र: तु Sumantra on his part, कैलासशिखरप्रभम् in lustre comparable to the peak of Kailasa, शक्रवेश्मसमप्रभम् resembling in splendour the abode of Indra, रुचिरम् lovely, रामवेश्म palace of Rama, ददर्श beheld.

40002906.author: Translation
40002906.content: Thereafter, Sumantra beheld the beautiful palace of Rama,  resembling  the abode of Indra or the peak of Kailasa in its splendour.

40002907.author: पदार्थः

40002916.author: पदार्थः
40002916.content: स: that, सारथि: charioteer, रामगृहाभिपातिना going towards the palace of Rama, वरूथिना (covered) with a wooden fender (as a defence against collision), वाजियुक्तेन harnessed with horses, रथेन by a chariot, नराकुलं (समाकुलम्) crowded with people, राजकुलम् royal palace, विराजयन् appearing, सर्वस्य all, पुरस्य city's, मनांसि minds, हर्षयन् delighting.

40002916.author: Translation
40002916.content: Mounted on a chariot, attached with a fender and driven by horses, the charioteer advanced towards the royal palace of Rama delighting the minds of the people of the city.

40002917.author: पदार्थः
40002917.content: तत: thereafter, स: सारथि: that charioteer, महाधनम् opulent, महत् magnificent, मृगै: with deer, मयूरैश्च with peacocks, समाकुलोल्बणम् with pervading beauty, शचीपते: इव like that of the consort of Sachi, Indra, वरार्हस्य of a befitting man, गृहं palace, समासाद्य having reached, प्रहृष्टरोमा बभूव was thrilled.

40002917.author: Translation
40002917.content: Having reached the palace abounding in deer and peacocks which resembled the magnificent and opulent abode of Indra, the charioteer was thrilled at the allpervading beauty of the place befitting Rama.

40002918.author: पदार्थः
40002918.content: स: that, रथी charioteer, तत्र there, कैलासनिभा: similar to Kailasa, स्वलंकृता: welldecorated, त्रिदशालयोपमा: like the abode of celestials, कक्ष्या: courtyards, प्रविश्य having entered, राममते close to Rama's heart, स्थितान् the waiting ones, बहून् many, वरान् best, प्रियान् friends, व्यपोह्य passing through, शुद्धान्तम् private apartment, उपस्थित: approached.

40002918.author: Translation
40002918.content: Having entered the welldecorated palace which was (lofty) like Kailasa, he crossed the courtyards comparable to the abode of the celestials, passed through the many bosom friends of Rama and entered the private apartment.

40002919.author: पदार्थः
40002919.content: तत्र there, स: he, जनानाम् people's, रामाभिषेकार्थकृता: acts done for the enthronement of Rama, हर्षयुक्ता: happy, नरेन्द्रसूनो: prince's (Rama's), अभिमंगलार्था: for his wellbeing, सर्वस्य from everyone, लोकस्य people's, प्रहृष्ट: full of delight, गिर: words, शुश्राव heard.

40002919.author: Translation
40002919.content: There he heard the happy words spoken by people about the enthronement of prince Rama and his future wellbeing.

40002920.author: पदार्थः
40002920.content: सुमन्त्र: Sumantra, महेन्द्रसद्मप्रतिमम् resembling the abode of Indra, मृगपक्षिजुष्टम् filled with animals and birds, मेरो: mount Meru's, उच्चं high, शृङ्गम् इव like a summit, प्रभया with  splendour, विभ्रजमानम् shining, रम्यम् beautiful, रामस्य वेश्म Rama's palace, ददर्श beheld.

40002920.author: Translation
40002920.content: Sumantra beheld Rama's palace which resembled the high summit of mount Meru shining with splendour. Filled with animals and birds, if looked like the abode of Indra.

40002921.author: पदार्थः
40002921.content: उपस्थितै: by men present, अञ्जलि कारकैश्च (अञ्जलि कारिभिश्च) paying obeisance with folded palms, सोपायनै: (with their hands ) full of gifts, विमुक्तयानै: having left their chariots, कोट्या in crores of, परार्धैश्च billions, जानपदै: villagers, जनैश्च citizens from towns, समाकुलं thronged, द्वारपथं gateway, ददर्श beheld.

40002921.author: Translation
40002921.content: He saw villagers and others in crores and parardhas, leaving their chariots and thronging the gateway, (some) paying obeisance with folded palms and (some) carrying gifts in their hands.

40002922.author: पदार्थः
40002922.content: तत: thereafter, महामेघमहीधराभम् resembling a great cloud or a vast mountain, प्रभिन्नम् ichor flowing from its temples, अत्यङ्कुशम् without caring for the goad, असह्यम् intolerant, उदग्रकायम् having a huge body, रामौपवाह्यम् fit to be mounted by Rama, रुचिरम्  beautiful, शत्रृञ्जयम् by name Satrunjaya, नागम् elephant, ददर्श beheld.

40002922.author: Translation
40002922.content: He beheld a beautiful elephant named Satrunjaya with a huge body on which Rama was to mount. It looked like a vast mountain or a huge cloud. With ichor flowing from his temples and without caring for the goad, the elephant was intolerant.

40002923.author: पदार्थः
40002923.content: स्वलंङ्कृतान् welladorned, साश्वरथान् with horses and chariots, सकुञ्जरान् with elephants, वल्लभान् dear to the king, अमात्यमुख्यांश्च important ministers also, ददर्श saw, सूत: charioteer, समन्तत: on all sides, सहितान् assembled, व्यपोह्य getting out of the way, समृद्धम् glorious, अन्त:पुरम् private apartment, आविवेश entered.

40002923.author: Translation
40002923.content: Important ministers who were dear to the king and welladorned arrived there on their  horses, chariots and elephants. Sumantra finding his way through the crowd of the people who assembled on all sides, entered the glorious private apartment of Rama.

40002924.author: पदार्थः
40002924.content: तत: afterwards, सारथि: charioteer, अद्रिकूटाचलमेघसन्निभम् similar to motionless cloud over a  mountain peak, महाविमानोपमवेश्मसंयुतम् surrounded by splendid rooms, मकर: crocodile,  prevented, प्रविवेश entered.

40002924.author: Translation
40002924.content: The palace looked like a mountain peak covered by a cloud and a great vimana surrounded by splendid apartments. The charioteer entered the palace unobstructed like a crocodile entering the ocean bristling with many gems. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे पञ्चदशःसर्गः।। Thus ends the fifteenth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the  holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
